nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: 08:00 Europe/Warsaw daily. Deposits are read for complete days only, up to yesterday.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: outputSheetId/outputSheetTab: where the list is written (tab "LA" must exist; it is overwritten on every run). historySheetId: the managers' "GR Base LA" spreadsheet, read only. callCooldownDays: a player found in a date-named tab from the N days before today is left out.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS date_from,     -- "all time": only bounds the partition scan; billing data exists from 2026-06 (checked against GR8)
           CURRENT_DATE      AS date_to_excl    -- up to and including yesterday
),
-- Successful deposits and withdrawals per player, all time.
payments AS (
    SELECT b.player_hk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                    THEN b.transaction_count ELSE 0 END)  AS deposit_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                    THEN b.amount_eur ELSE 0 END)         AS deposit_amount_eur,
           SUM(CASE WHEN b.transaction_type = 'withdrawal'
                    THEN ABS(b.amount_eur) ELSE 0 END)    AS withdrawal_amount_eur,
           MAX(CASE WHEN b.transaction_type = 'deposit'
                     AND b.transaction_count > 0
                    THEN b.as_of_date END)                AS last_deposit_date
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_billing_daily b
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE b.as_of_date >= p.date_from
      AND b.as_of_date <  p.date_to_excl
      AND b.transaction_type   IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
      AND b.transaction_status = 'Success'
      AND b.is_test = false
      AND b.brand IN ('LACASINO')
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Column names are the sheet headers and must match COLUMNS in Parse Athena Page and Build Sheet Payload.
SELECT ps.brand                                                    AS "Brand",
       ps.player_id                                                AS "User ID",
       dp.first_name                                               AS "First name",
       dp.phone                                                    AS "Phone Number",
       d.deposit_amount_eur                                        AS "Total Deposit",
       ROUND(CAST(d.deposit_amount_eur AS DOUBLE)
             / NULLIF(d.deposit_count, 0), 2)                      AS "Average Deposit",
       d.deposit_count                                             AS "Deposit Count",
       DATE_DIFF('day', d.last_deposit_date, CURRENT_DATE)         AS "LDD",
       ROUND(CAST(d.deposit_amount_eur - d.withdrawal_amount_eur AS DOUBLE) * 100
             / NULLIF(CAST(d.deposit_amount_eur AS DOUBLE), 0), 2) AS "Hold %",
       ps.risk_casino_segment                                      AS "Player Status"
FROM payments d
JOIN operator_ro_normcasino.agg_player_summary ps
  ON ps.player_hk = d.player_hk
JOIN operator_ro_normcasino.d_player dp
  ON dp.player_hk = d.player_hk
WHERE d.deposit_count > 0
  AND ps.is_test = false
  AND ps.brand IN ('LACASINO')
  -- Only players with a phone number.
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(dp.phone), '') IS NOT NULL
  -- No streamers.
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM operator_ro_normcasino.d_risk_tags_summary st
        WHERE st.player_hk = d.player_hk
          AND st.tag_id = 39
  )
ORDER BY "Brand", "LDD", "User ID"",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-depositing-players-export-la-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~10 min)

nodes.name: Get Athena Results Page
nodes.notes: Called once per page. The first call comes from Athena Query State and has no nextToken; later calls come back from More Pages? carrying the token of the page before.

nodes.name: More Pages?
nodes.notes: true -> fetch the next page with this NextToken; false -> every page is in, read the call history.

nodes.name: List Sheet Tabs
nodes.notes: Tab names of the managers' "GR Base LA" spreadsheet. Select Recent Tabs picks the date-named ones inside the cooldown window.

nodes.name: Recent Tabs Found?
nodes.notes: true -> read the recent date tabs; false -> nobody to exclude, build the list straight away.

nodes.name: Read Recent Tabs
nodes.notes: One batchGet for every recent date tab, columns A:Z. UNFORMATTED_VALUE keeps ids as plain numbers/strings.

nodes.name: Clear Sheet
nodes.notes: Clears columns A:Z of the tab, wider than the data, so leftovers from a longer run or an older column layout do not linger. Runs only after Athena and the call history were both read.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ range: $('Build Sheet Payload').first().json.range, majorDimension: 'ROWS', values: $('Build Sheet Payload').first().json.values }) }}

nodes.name: Write Rows to Sheet
nodes.notes: One values.update call: header row plus every player. Idempotent, so a retry rewrites the same cells.
